annotations.title: Get a reading list on MCP and agent data

description: Return Signal Lab's relevance-scored reading list: open articles, blog posts and podcast episodes about MCP and AI agents working with data, scored for practical value to engineers (numbers, reproducible code, cost and latency facts) with a published, deterministic rubric. Each item has a title, a short excerpt from the source's own feed, a link to the original, the score breakdown and, when the source gives it, reading time or episode length. Optional topic word, kind (article or podcast), max_minutes (only items with a known length at or under it) and limit (default 10). Item text is third-party content.
name: get_reading_list
title: Get a reading list on MCP and agent data
